summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Form 6-K on 2026-11-03 furnishing its interim consolidated financial statements for the period ended 2026-09-30, signed by CFO Ricardo Bottas. The exhibit comprises statements of financial position, income by function, comprehensive income, changes in equity, and direct-method cash flows with accompanying notes; currencies include CLP, UF, ARS, US$, COP, BRL and PYG. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation appears. This is a routine periodic reporting equivalent to a domestic quarterly report, not a special situation; watch only for balance-sheet or liquidity disclosures relevant to credit and equity holders.
